title: Merchandise Purchases — Fulfilment Terms: Cancellation Cut-off, Pickup Hold and Mattress Comfort Exchange
content:
Fulfilment terms of **Merchandise Purchases** by merchandise class.

## Cancellation cut-off and store pickup hold

| Merchandise class | Last fulfilment state in which an order line can be cancelled | Store pickup order held after it is ready (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Apparel, Shoes & Accessories | before shipment | 7 |
| Beauty & Fragrance | before shipment | 7 |
| Home & Kitchen | before shipment | 7 |
| Electronics & Small Appliances | before shipment | 7 |
| Fine Jewelry & Watches | before shipment | 3 |
| Designer Handbags & Luxury | before shipment | 3 |
| Furniture & Mattresses | before shipment | not applicable (no store pickup) |

## Mattress comfort exchange

| Merchandise class | Comfort exchange window (nights after delivery) | Nights slept before an exchange | Comfort exchanges per mattress purchase record | Comfort exchange fee (excluding the replacement's delivery fee) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Furniture & Mattresses | 120 | 30 | 1 | $0.00 |
| All six other classes | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |

### Points of reading

- A pickup order of a Fine Jewelry & Watches unit is held 3 days after it is ready; one of an Apparel, Shoes & Accessories unit 7 days.
- Only the Furniture & Mattresses class carries comfort exchange terms: a window of 120 nights, at least 30 nights slept, one exchange per mattress purchase record, at a fee of $0.00.
